CustomField.label: Days In Stage
CustomField.description: Whole days since Stage_Entry_Date__c, computed live. 0 for any closed deal (IsClosed - true for Closed Won and Dead/Pass). Blank if Stage_Entry_Date__c is not yet stamped. Drives the Item 4 stalled-deal reminder threshold.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days the deal has sat in its current stage. Recalculated automatically; cannot be edited.
